description: Lingot kernel v1 (seed): the shared operating-contract + pack + boot templates and default skills every venture inherits, extracted from Ortova's organic harness per the P2 extraction map. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE of the kernel version -- harness-kernel.ts reads `kernel` from here, so the emit path (AGENTS.md) and the compile path (packs) always stamp the same number. LIVE: contract-base.md renders each venture's AGENTS.md through the emit path. SHADOW: the pack + skill compilation (`harness compile`) still writes only to the shadow registry; packs+skills graduate per venture on the parity gate + Felix's adopt word, tracked by compiled.json.shadow -- an adoption status, not a version suffix.
